title: Sweep Result 1.1
description: The factory's answer to a Sweep Request 1.1 (ADR-0004): the kinds of things seen at one Place, and any Containers seen inside it with their own things. Imported after the person confirms or edits it. No quantities: this is knowledge of where kinds of things live, not stock control.

placeName.description: Echo of the target Place name, so the person can confirm before import.

items.description: Things kept loose at the Place itself.

containers.description: Containers seen inside the Place (a shoebox, a labelled bin), each with the things visible in it. One level only: a Container inside one of these gets its own photo.

aliases.description: Other names for the Container, e.g. the words on its label.

unsure.description: True when this might not be a separate Container.

note.description: One plain sentence the person should see, e.g. that part of the photo was too dark to read.

aliases.description: Optional alternate names the household might search by.

unsure.description: True when the thing is only partly visible or hard to name; the confirm step shows it unticked.
